name: Usulelo lwesikhumba somngundo
tagline: Unyawo lomdlali, intshulube, i-jock itch. Kutshiphu ukunyanga.

what_is_it.heading: Usulelo lwesikhumba sefungal ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Usulelo lolusu lomngundo lubangelwa yifungi encinci engenabungozi ehlala kwiindawo ezifudumeleyo, ezifumileyo zomzimba. Xa zikhula kakhulu, zibangela ukurhawuzelelwa, amaxolo, amaxesha amaninzi amile okwesangqa. Kuyacaphukisa kodwa kulula ukunyanga.
paragraphs: Iindidi eziqhelekileyo: unyawo lomdlali (phakathi kweenzwane), i-jock itch (i-groin), i-ringworm (naphi na - ngokwenene i-fungus, kungekhona i-worm), i-fungus ye-nail, i-scalp kubantwana. Ngaphandle kwamagama ahlukeneyo, zonke zibangelwa yifungi efanayo.

Uninzi luphendula kwi-counter-counter antifungal cream efakwe kwiiveki ezi-2-4. Ezinye - i-fungus ye-nail, izifo ze-scalp - zifuna iipilisi ezichazwe ngugqirha. Abantu abanesifo seswekile, amajoni omzimba abuthathaka, okanye i-HIV banokufumana usulelo oluqatha kakhulu okanye oluphindaphindayo.

items.headline: Ixhaphake kakhulu
items.body: Unyawo loMgijimi lulodwa luchaphazela ukuya kuthi ga kwi-70% yabantu abadala ngexesha elithile. Umsundulu kunye nejock itch zixhaphakile kwihlabathi liphela.

items.headline: Kulula ukunyanga
items.body: Uninzi lwezifo zolusu lomngundo ziyacaca ngekhrimu ye-over-the-counter kwiiveki ezi-2-4. Ixabiso eliphantsi, elifumaneka kuyo nayiphi na ikhemesti.

items.headline: Iyasulela
items.body: Ifungus isasazeka kwiitawuli, imigangatho yeshawari, iimethi zokuzilolonga, izihlangu ekwabelwana ngazo. Yinyange - kwaye ungabelani ngeetawuli okanye izihlangu ngexesha lonyango.

items.headline: Gcina yomile
items.body: Umngundo uthanda ulusu olufudumeleyo, olufumileyo. Yomisa kakuhle emva kokuhlamba, tshintsha iikawusi ezibilayo kunye nempahla yangaphantsi, zikhuphe umoya izihlangu. Uthintelo lumalunga nokomisa.

pull_quote.text: Ukuba i-'ring' esikhumbeni ayicaci nge-antifungal cream kwiiveki ezi-4, bonana nogqirha. Ezinye iimeko zolusu zikhangeleka ngathi ziintshulube - kwaye i-steroid cream iya kwenza intshulube yokwenyani ibe mandundu.

signs.heading: Iipateni eziqhelekileyo
signs.lede: Usulelo lomngundo zonke zabelana ngokurhawuzelelwa, amaxolo, inkangeleko emile okweringi - kodwa apho zivela khona ziyahluka.

items.title: Unyawo lomdlali
items.description: Ukubetha, ukukhwabanisa, ukukhupha isikhumba phakathi kweenzwane - ngakumbi i-4 kunye ne-5. Inokusasazeka kwiisoli. Uyanuka. Iba mbi ehlotyeni kunye nezihlangu ezibilayo.

items.title: Umbungu (tinea corporis)
items.description: Ubomvu ojikelezayo (okanye umnyama, kwisikhumba esiMnyama) i-scaly patch eneziko elicacileyo - ibonakala njengendandatho. Kancinci ukukhula ngaphandle. Okuqhelekileyo kwiingalo, intamo, umzimba. Kuyarhawuzelelwa.

items.title: Jock ukurhawuzelelwa kunye ne-scalp tinea
items.description: I-Jock itch: i-red, i-rash ebomvu kwi-groin folds - ixhaphake kumadoda, emva kokubila. I-scalp ringworm: ukulahleka kweenwele ezinqabileyo kunye nokulinganisa - okuqhelekileyo kubantwana, kufuna iipilisi.

spreads.heading: Indlela usulelo lomngundo olusasazeka ngayo
yes: Ukudibana ngokuthe ngqo kwesikhumba kunye nomntu osulelekileyo
Iitawuli ekwabelwana ngazo, ilinen yokulala, iimpahla, iibrashi zeenwele
Ukuhamba unganxibanga zihlangu kwimigangatho engcolisekileyo - iishawara zikawonke wonke, amagumbi okutshintsha umthambo, iidekhi zokuqubha
Izihlangu ekwabelwana ngazo, ingakumbi izixhobo zemidlalo
Ukususela kwizixhobo zokubila kwiindawo zokujima okanye kwezemidlalo
no: Ukudibana okuqhelekileyo njengokuxhawula izandla okanye ukuwola

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuphepha ukuyifumana kwakhona
prevention.lede: Umngundo uyabuya ukuba iimeko zihlala zishushu kwaye zifumile. Imikhwa emincinci yemihla ngemihla ikhusela ukuphindaphinda okuninzi.

items.title: Yomisa kakuhle emva kokuhlamba
items.description: Ngokukodwa phakathi kweenzwane, kwi-groin, phantsi kwamabele, kwii-folds zesikhumba. Yomisa kancinci. Ulusu olomileyo likhaya elingenabubele lefungus.

items.title: Ikotoni ecocekileyo, tshintsha rhoqo
items.description: Iikawusi zomqhaphu kunye neengubo zangaphantsi ziphefumla ngcono kunezokwenziwa. Guqula yonke imihla nasemva kokubila. Musa ukuphinda unxibe iimpahla zokujima ezibilayo.

items.title: Musa ukuhamba unganxibanga zihlangu esidlangalaleni
items.description: Iishawa kawonke-wonke, amagumbi okutshintsha ijim, iidekhi zokuqubha - nxiba iislops okanye iimbadada. Uninzi losulelo lwenyawo lomngundo luvela kwezi ndawo.

items.title: Musa ukwabelana ngeetawuli okanye izihlangu
items.description: Nditsho namalungu osapho. Ukuba umntu unosulelo lomngundo, sebenzisa iitawuli ezahlukeneyo de luphele.

items.title: Qala phezu-the-counter antifungal cream
items.description: I-Clotrimazole okanye i-terbinafine - sebenzisa kabini ngosuku kwindawo echaphazelekayo kunye ne-2cm ngeenxa zonke. Qhubeka uqhubeka iiveki ezi-2 emva kokuba irhashalala iphelile ukuthintela ukubuya.

items.title: Gcina indawo yomile kwaye ibonakaliswe emoyeni
items.description: Musa ukubopha ibhanti. Nxiba iimpahla ezikhululekileyo. Vumela ulusu luphefumle. Umgubo (kungekhona ukhilimu) kusasa unokunceda kwi-groin okanye ezinyaweni zokufunxa umbilo.

items.title: Phatha umthombo
items.description: Hlamba zonke iitawuli, iibhedi, kunye neempahla ezichaphazele isifo emanzini ashushu. Lahla okanye ubulale iintsholongwane kwizihlangu ezidala ukuba unyawo lwembaleki luhlala lubuya.

items.title: Ukuba akukho ngcono kwiiveki ezi-4 - bonana nogqirha
items.description: Ezinye iimeko ezikhangelekayo aziphenduli kwi-antifungal. I-Nail fungus kunye ne-scalp worm zifuna iipilisi. Iiklinikhi zikarhulumente zibonelela ngazo zombini simahla.

items.title: Ukuba unesifo seswekile okanye i-HIV - yiya kwangoko
items.description: Usulelo lomngundo lunokuba nzima kwaye lusasazeka ngokukhawuleza. Yiya ekliniki ngokokuqala ngqa—ungalindi ukuba uzame evenkileni kangangeeveki.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uninzi lwezifo zolusu lomngundo zicacile ngekrimu engabizi kakhulu kwi-counter-counter. Ukuba abakwenzi oko, iikliniki zikarhulumente zibonelela ngonyango lwasimahla olubhalwe ngugqirha.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Uvavanyo lwasimahla kunye nomyalelo wonyango lwe-antifungal ukuba luyimfuneko
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo
